note: Proposed risk cases for the verification campaign, one list per console, in priority order. Titles are matched against the file names of the ROM folder (region and revision tags ignored, USA/World/Europe preferred); arcade sets are matched by set name. A case missing from the folder is listed as unmatched and skipped. Reasons come from the repository documents named in 'source'; a case is a place where the converter is known to be harder to satisfy or to refuse, not a promise that it passes. 'expect': 'refusal' marks a case where the documented outcome is a clean refusal of the cartridge.
